essence: Placing the first and last seed-syllables on both sides effects the removal of poison.
Even a victim bitten by Takṣaka should become free of poison at once.
The person is certainly and quickly freed from two kinds of poison.
One should place the three mantra syllables while taking the guru as the form of the deity.
Placing the three mantra syllables with those fingers constitutes the excellent procedure.
